dashboard.name: GDS control plane
dashboard.description: Operational view; the local SQLite journal remains recovery authority.

panels.title: Operation outcomes
panels.query: SELECT event_name, COUNT(*) AS events FROM "${GDS_OTEL_STREAM}" WHERE operation_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY event_name ORDER BY events DESC

panels.title: Partial operations
panels.query: SELECT operation_id, plan_id, device_id, MAX(_timestamp) AS last_seen FROM "${GDS_OTEL_STREAM}" WHERE event_name = 'operation.partial' GROUP BY operation_id, plan_id, device_id ORDER BY last_seen DESC

panels.title: Write-set lock conflicts
panels.query: SELECT repository_id, COUNT(*) AS conflicts FROM "${GDS_OTEL_STREAM}" WHERE event_name = 'lock.conflict' GROUP BY repository_id ORDER BY conflicts DESC

panels.title: Stale evidence
panels.query: SELECT evidence_type, harness_id, device_id, COUNT(*) AS stale_count FROM "${GDS_OTEL_STREAM}" WHERE freshness_state IN ('stale','expired','unavailable') GROUP BY evidence_type, harness_id, device_id

panels.title: Exporter backlog and drops
panels.query: SELECT name, MAX(value) AS current_value FROM "${GDS_OTEL_STREAM}" WHERE name IN ('gds.telemetry.pending','gds.telemetry.dropped') GROUP BY name

panels.title: Release gate failures
panels.query: SELECT channel, error_class, COUNT(*) AS failures FROM "${GDS_OTEL_STREAM}" WHERE event_name = 'release.gate.rejected' GROUP BY channel, error_class

alerts.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM "${GDS_OTEL_STREAM}" WHERE event_name = 'operation.partial'
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(value),0) AS value FROM "${GDS_OTEL_STREAM}" WHERE name = 'gds.telemetry.dropped'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM "${GDS_OTEL_STREAM}" WHERE event_name = 'release.gate.rejected'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM "${GDS_OTEL_STREAM}" WHERE freshness_state IN ('expired','unavailable')
